profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at TripAdvisor
profile.summary: I am a professional computer whisperer.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
♦ Worked with students enrolled in CSE 2100: Data Structures and Algorithms to better their understanding of key concepts and assist those struggling with course assignments.
♦ Held weekly office hours to help students with coding assignments and problem sets
♦ Prepared content and lead exam reviews for the courses multiple midterms

positions.title: Shop Technician
positions.description:
♦ Worked as first point of contact for both students and faculty, providing assistance for networking, email client and university account issues. Diagnosed hardware issues, reformatted computers and fixed OS level problems using Windows command prompt or Mac & Linux terminal.
♦ Two time employee of the week

positions.title: CTO App Development Intern
positions.description:
♦ Designed, developed, and secured a dynamically generated web survey to assess application efficiency using technologies such as AngularJS, Oracle DB and Spring RESTful Web framework.
 ♦ Acted as Scrum Master throughout the development cycle. Gathered requirements, held daily stand-ups and generated burn down charts as well as keeping an extremely colorful kanban board. 
 ♦ Instigated several successful office pranks, including wrapping managers desk in saran wrap and molding a co-workers mug into strawberry jello.

volunteerExperiences.description: Solo Instructor for the Needham High school GWC branch with some really amazing young women.
